test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Varun, Kashyap, Anil, Johnson, Samson and Prasad are sitting in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order. Varun and Kashyap sit at the extreme ends. Anil is sitting to the immediate left of Varun. Only one person sits between Anil and Samson. Johnson is not an immediate neighbour of Kashyap.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of Kashyap?
solution:
**Varun, Kashyap, Anil, Johnson, Samson and Prasad** are sitting in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order.

1. Varun and Kashyap sit at the extreme ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ddb2210ca0f25ef1aef48e06e1a057f349bf981ad2add031b1355b4183c6046.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bfc9640acb5fb228753bc2487a195a895facef7072324f6da0ded9b30c5b5db.png] 

2. Anil is sitting to the immediate left of Varun.

The above condition cannot be satisfied in Case I, so it is elimianted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/324627ea27c2fd9b56535b25c0da407b1492f105489f747074369b92c4280362.png] 

3. Only one person sits between Anil and Samson. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14dd4c707dc94ee4dfd01a8d5449962fd067c94bbdaecfe0418fc56dca9d0d4d.png] 

4. Johnson is not an immediate neighbour of Kashyap.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b49fcf5d98ddcf7109e29367d8b85553a0cc1f53e7fc3f0200629ce89aec86f.png] 

Johnson is sitting between Samson and Anil, as it is the only possible position for Johnson to occupy.

Remaining person Prasad is sitting to the immediate right of Kashyap as it is the only possible position for Prasad to occupy.

Therefore, the final arrangement will be as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1961c1e1515e11909e8e4dcef8cc470608f578c4143a51c2cedd0a2621773f19.png] 

Prasad is sitting to the immediate right of Kashyap.

Hence, ‘**Prasad**’ is the correct answer.
